welcomeLead: Choose a language and a color style. They stay independent.
gateLead: The Ashen Gate stands open. Two roads leave the threshold, and only one of them ends in daylight.
crossroadsA: Lanterns burn along the left road, climbing toward a tower that should have fallen years ago.
crossroadsB: The right road drops into a chapel with a broken roof. Something inside is counting your steps.
marketA: Hooded traders sell maps that change when you blink. One merchant offers a shorter way, if you can pay with courage.
marketB: He points between the stalls, toward the same ruined chapel the forest has been hiding.
towerA: The stair ends at a cold window. From here the gate is a small gold line, and the chapel bell rings once below.
towerB: No door leads onward. The only honest choice is to return and pick the other road.
chapelLead: A six-sided die decides the chapel. A higher roll breaks the warden. A lower roll is death.
chapelReady: The warden raises a rusted sword. Roll higher than the enemy.
rollWin: You rolled {hero}. The warden rolled {enemy}. The sword falls.
rollLose: You rolled {hero}. The warden rolled {enemy}. The chapel goes dark.
rollTie: You both rolled {hero}. The warden waits. Roll again.
victoryBody: Dawn finds the valley quiet. The warden is gone, and the Ashen Gate no longer asks you to choose.
deathBody: The dice were lower than the warden's. The chapel keeps your name, until you walk through the gate once more.
